overview.text: He calls the renewal of the utility users tax a vital source of funds. He supports continuing the public safety tax for police and fire services. He says the city must anticipate changing state housing laws and find ways to meet the mandates. He proposes revisiting the findings of a 2020 economic development committee to consider actionable solutions. He says he supports transparency and wants to be a resource for residents to ask questions and learn about potential barriers to accessing information.
